page.overview:
Who is Dijuka?

Dijuka was a Dybrinthe Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. Dijuka served on the Jedi High Council. Sometime later, after the Council received a message of help from the Scalvi, Dijuka discussed the matter with the other Masters. When Pra-Tre Veter questioned who the Scalvi were, Dijuka responded that what mattered was that the Scalvi were in trouble.

Around 382 BBY, the Jedi was present when Porter Engle informed the Council that Barash Silvain took a vow to distance herself from the Jedi Order to find out what the Force wanted her to do.

Master Dijuka would be present during a Jedi High Council meeting where the members heard a message by the Scalvi requesting help. Although it wasn’t yet known to them who the Scalvi were, as pointed out by master Pra-Tre Veter, Dijuka reinforced the fact that what mattered was that they were in trouble and the council should help them.
